title: ☁️ Cloud Sync
summary: View what's new in Raycast v0.69
body_markdown:
[v0.69](https://www.raycast.com/changelog/macos/0-69) July 16, 2026 The wait is over. Cloud Sync *beta* is here. You can now keep your Raycast data in sync across macOS v1, macOS v2, Windows and iOS. Switch seamlessly between your work and home computers, take notes on the go, or start an AI chat on your phone and continue it on your laptop. These are just a few ways Cloud Sync helps your work flow across devices. Cloud Sync is available to Raycast Pro subscribers. ## ✨ New - **Cloud Sync** : Sync your data across macOS V1, macOS V2 beta, Windows beta and iOS - **Cloud Sync:** Customize what gets synced across your devices - **Cloud Sync:** Manage your synced devices - **Clipboard History** : Added new Reset Paste Sequence command - **Root Search** : Added ability to show favorites in compact mode ## 💎 Improvements - **AI** :`
` tags in AI markdown now render as line breaks - **AI** : @-mentions get preserved when copying a selection in the UI - **AI** : @-mentions left in the composer when closing AI Chat get preserved when re-opening AI Chat again - **AI Chat** : Consecutive tool calls get collapsed into a group to reduce visual clutter - **AI Chat** : Auto-loaded extensions now get persisted into the AI Extensions list of a chat and therefore stay loaded after a restart of AI Chat - **AI Settings** : Added default reasoning effort settings to models view - **Database:** Improved database recovery when the Application Support folder has been mistakenly removed or there is a transient keychain failure - **Extensions Menu Bar Items:** Optimized performance and reduced energy usage caused by Menu Bar items updates - **File Search:** Improved index compaction checkpoints to reduce index size on disk - **Raycast Focus:** Support Focus Categories in Import & Export Settings & Data - **UI** : Improved ghost dropdown button design (Settings selects) - **Window Management** : layout previews now show a hint when width or height are set to` auto` ## 🐞 Fixes - **AI Chat** : Fixed sidebar peek getting stuck when blurring window during peek open animation - **AI Chat** : Fixed transparent overlaid sidebar - **Apple Shortcuts:** Fixed running shortcuts requiring already provided automation permission - **Capture Window:** Fixed window capture failing with non-default Interface Size - **Changelog** : Fixed bad heading baseline alignment (with emoji) - **Clipboard History:** Fixed bookmark triggering in Microsoft Office applications when copying - **Clipboard History:** Fixed missing image when copying Figma layers as PNG - **Hotkeys:** Fixed single-tap hotkey firing after` fn` combo (` fn` +key) - **Hotkeys:** Fixed Script Commands hotkeys not being re-assignable after deleting a script - **Hyper Key:** Improved Quick Press ABC input source switch reliability - **File Search:** File Search no longer prevents Raycast from launching if the user’s disk is full - **Root Search** : Fixed doubly-scaled icon in node command items - **Root Search** : Fixed an alignment issue with compact command items - **Search Menu Bar Items:** Fixed substring matching when searching for an item - **Search Menu Bar Items:** Fixed occasional missing frontmost application icon - **Switch Windows:** Fixed freeze caused by unresponsive app - **UI** : Fixed potential crashes with virtual list/grid - **UI** : Fixed date picker natural language edge cases - **UI** : Fixed date picker dropping explicit clock times - **UI** : Fixed calendar item icon on low-res screens - **UI** : Fixed some icons scaling - **UI** : Fixed a regression in preview/details spacing
